observations: Parent full-board previews and details carry the reviewed SHA prefix 742ae27bb1d1; independent local plots were regenerated from this exact native snapshot.
The Kelvin pair is on F.Cu near U1/R1/R56 and does not project onto the switch pad. The switch connection stays on the front layer.
U10 temperature inputs and nearby RC components form a compact grid. The long power routes remain distinct from the short sense branches.
C12 and C14 connect directly to the TPS63802 pin-side branches, with ground returns beside the converter.
All 167 reference tokens are present in native board text. Nominals are readable on the bottom view; multi-component callouts have borders and group/scale headings.
R70 nominal is now local at B.Silkscreen (45.5,85.499999), aligned below its component, with 0.8 mm font and 0.10 mm stroke.
COLD and BALANCER 1/2 boundaries are clearly distinguishable inside SH1. The pin-1 markers of U8/U9 are visible beside the intended sides.
The board edge, USB-C cable corridor, SMA/RF region, shield stitching and two filter capacitor grids remain recognizable and unobstructed.
limitations: Image review complements native geometry and DRC; it does not establish manufactured-board EMC performance.
